explanation: The selected plan changes src/githubAuth.ts so credential helpers render shell-quoted process.execPath instead of /usr/bin/env node, but its approved test list omits test/mirror.test.ts, which already asserts that exact legacy helper string on every BareMirror Git call.

additionalPaths.reason: BareMirror uses gitCredentialArgs from src/githubAuth.ts; test/mirror.test.ts:94 expects !/usr/bin/env node '/coord/dist/main.js' auth git-credential, so following the plan's githubAuth change fails this existing fast test unless that assertion is updated in-scope.
